key_facts: UPDATED Monday August 24 (T+1d to Aug 25 res; Pennsylvania 0.55, Ohio 0.24, Maryland 0.04, Utah 0.03, Florida 0.02; sum=0.88, outside=0.12): (1) STILL ZERO 2026 US MEASLES DEATHS REPORTED THROUGH MONDAY AUG 24: Both Exa search (Aug 21-24) and full local scan of 2,885 Aug 24 articles (553 CBS News) confirm no state health department has yet announced a 2026 measles fatality. (2) EPIDEMIOLOGICAL SEVERITY & TIMING (CIDRAP & Phila Inquirer Aug 21): National YTD reached 2,777 cases (+211 in latest week, more than doubling from +101 prior week), 7% national hospitalization rate (~194 hospitalizations YTD). Pennsylvania (+89/wk = 42.2% of US weekly cases; 379 YTD; ~200 in August alone) has 70 hospitalizations (22 children) = 18.5% hospitalization rate (2.6x national average, ~36% of all YTD US hospitalizations and likely >55% of active Aug hospitalizations), concentrated in under-vaccinated Lancaster (181), Chester (41), Mifflin (25), Lebanon (21), Centre (13) plus Pittsburgh/UPMC Childrens Hospital ER case, with physicians warning true case counts are far higher. Ohio jumped +73/wk (34.6% of US weekly cases; 142 YTD across 15 counties, led by Ashtabula=40). Together PA+OH are 76.8% (162/211) of weekly cases; PA earlier Aug head start + 70 hospitalizations supports ~2.3:1 hazard ratio over OH for an Aug 25 fatality announcement (PA 0.55, OH 0.24). (3) TAIL REFINEMENT: Replaced South Carolina (0.02; NIH/Acting CDC Director Jay Bhattacharya explicitly confirmed Aug 9 that South Carolina outbreak ended) with Maryland (0.04; active 3-county Aug outbreaks in St. Marys, Carroll, Cecil adjacent to Lancaster PA with 27 cases since July 15 / 31 YTD); kept Utah (0.03) and Florida (0.02; 155 YTD) for residual/delayed vital-records tail, with 0.12 outside (Delaware 22 YTD, Virginia, South Carolina, NY, TX, CA, etc.).
next_review_trigger: Resolves tomorrow Aug 25 upon official state health department announcement of the first 2026 U.S. measles death.
